criteria.note: [V reread 2026-11-20] amended 2026-11-12 from email to phone first. Built half: SignInForm and CodeEntry (email, then a 6-digit code; #946, Reviewed by, green on 5e902cb) are still the way in, with Google in EmailFirstSignup; after it the profile screen takes the 18+/Terms box and the zip (#497, review-skipped; src/proxy.ts sends a member with no name to /onboarding, #1032), and it still requires a legal name (2-120) and a display name, the opposite of 'never a legal name'. The phone step (#282, #749, PhoneVerifyStep) exists and is off until PHONE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED and the Twilio keys (#707, open, needs-fix); it sends the code through Supabase, not Twilio Verify's pooled senders (#1290), and no Apple sign-in exists. 'What they plan to do' is asked on the waitlist (criterion 6), not at sign-up. Missing: phone first, Verify, no legal name, Apple. Ticket #1280 (open, filed 2026-11-12, no comment but the lint's); the legal-name field also reverses F077.1. The check `signup-screens.test.tsx` is marked `guards F081.1 partial` for the old email path. Smoked: unknown, sign-up has no live address in the smoke (/onboarding and the phone step are not smoked and the smoke signs in as builders).
